narrative: The foul sheet on the boards beside the blanket, one hand flat to hold it, the other with the pen. Three short lines stand clearer than the blot they come from. No face. The same margin, a second line, the pen set down in the fold so it will not roll. The stone from the orchard bench is not in the room. One line under the rose, and the rest of the sheet still foul. The cup of ale sits at the edge of the blanket.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote three lines one-handed, and set the pen down.
